description: Coordinates GitHub Projects and issues with repository binding, version boards, P0–P3 triage, minimal issue templates, session titles, and verified progress and closure synchronization.

changes: Split acceptance criteria into agent-verifiable and user-verified items with explicit evidence and pass conditions.
Require user approval of acceptance ownership and explicit user results for complex gesture or visual acceptance.
Keep issues open during user acceptance and prevent PR auto-closure from bypassing pending acceptance.
